intro.text: A man in Kholinar, known to Wit.

items.text: Cob's small child was killed during the fighting around Kholinar, and his wife Kheni fell into a catatonic state. Cob stayed close to look after her. Wit, in disguise, met them and other refugees several times. When Wit brought them an orphaned girl to care for, Cob asked if he could stay a little longer, which Wit thought no one had ever asked him before.
